statements: After signing in, people land on the home page even when they were on their way somewhere else. Make afterSignIn(req) in src/signin.mjs send them to the address in the next query parameter.

Links to other pages of this site come as a path, and may carry a query and a fragment, which are kept. Older emails link to the site with a full address on our own origin, which is in src/config.mjs, and those work too and go to the same place.
Everything else that could arrive in next goes to the home page.
afterSignIn returns { status, headers }. The new behaviour has tests in test/. Keep the change focused on what this ticket needs.
brief: Add the redirect after sign-in, as the numbered statements describe. Follow the conventions already in the code and change only what the ticket needs.
